subject: Handoff: ClearPath Health — onboarding custody & kickoff scheduling
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-12-13T15:22:00-08:00
Subject: Handoff: ClearPath Health — onboarding and implementation commitments

Hi team,

Wrapping up the sales side for ClearPath Health (see deal RDW-2026-4687). We signed last night — procurement grabbed the final signatures and the countersigned SOW is attached (SOW_ClearPath_v1.pdf). Key highlights and known constraints: 

- Contract & billing: annual commitment (50M tokens/month baseline) with a 30-day net invoice. Procurement contact is procurement@clearpathhealth.com (CC'd on the final DocuSign).
- Security: customer completed the initial questionnaire; they require SOC2 evidence and a short architecture diagram showing private linking to their VPC. Security questionnaire attached (security_questionnaire_clearpath.xlsx).
- Tech footprint: primary integration will use Redwood Dedicated with burst to hosted for non-sensitive workloads. They plan to pin to rdx-large-v2 model family, initial sequence lengths up to 1024.
- Migration expectations: pilot (2-week) -> staging -> production; baseline acceptance criteria in SOW sections 3–5 (response time 95th pct < 350ms).
- Risks: 1) VPC peering approval may take 2–3 weeks on their side; 2) They are strict about audit logging retention (13 months).

Action items for CS/Implementation team:
1) Assign primary CS owner + SE for the kickoff and pre-kickoff checklist.
2) Confirm an internal pre-kick call this week to review the SOW and acceptance tests.
3) We should schedule the external kickoff for the week of Dec 20 if possible — ClearPath prefers mornings PST.

Attachments: SOW_ClearPath_v1.pdf, security_questionnaire_clearpath.xlsx

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-13T17:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: ClearPath Health — onboarding and implementation commitments

Thanks Ben — looping in CS team to own the delivery. Monica will be primary owner for the onboarding and acceptance criteria; Vivek will act as the SE for architecture and VPC peering. Karthik, please remain the escalation owner for commercial/contract questions.

Monica / Vivek, please do the following before the external kickoff: 
- Review the attached SOW and call out any items that need clarification or rewording (esp. SOW sections 3–5 and the acceptance test matrix).
- Confirm we can meet the 95th percentile latency SLO with the proposed rdx-large-v2 profile and outline any needed benchmarking windows.
- Prepare a short pre-kick checklist (inbox items: access, test data plan, invite list, security evidence review).

I can host an internal 30-minute pre-kick on Dec 15 at 10:00 AM PST — will that work for you both?

Hannah Schmitt
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: ClearPath Health — onboarding and implementation commitments

Acknowledged and taking ownership.

Quick notes from my side after a first pass on the SOW: 
- Acceptance tests: I'll convert the SOW acceptance criteria into a short verification checklist and QA plan — expect that by EOD Dec 15.
- Security: Vivek, can you confirm if we need a dedicated private endpoint or if shared private routing + strict network ACLs will suffice for their retention requirements? I'll also reach out to Security for SOC2 artifact packaging.
- Kickoff: Dec 20–22 mornings PST sounds feasible. I'll propose Dec 21 10:30 AM PST as the external kickoff and will send a placeholder invite once you all confirm.

Pre-kick agenda (internal):
1) Walk SOW acceptance checklist and identify any test-data needs.
2) VPC/network/credentials plan and owner mapping.
3) Define initial pilot deliverables and success signals (duration, traffic profile, rollback plan).
4) Communication cadence and post-kick Handoff doc to CS Ops.

I'll attach the checklist + initial runbook to the kickoff invite.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Tara Rios <tara.rios@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearpathhealth.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-14T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: ClearPath Health — onboarding and implementation commitments

Hi Monica / Hannah — thanks for the update and congrats on getting us over the finish line. Dec 21 at 10:30 AM PST works for our team. Can you include the SE and a small list of artifacts we should have prepared on our side?

Requested items from us:
- Short tech contact list (names + emails) for VPC approvals
- Any sample request/response payloads you want us to provision (we can provide sanitized test data)
- Link to the kickoff dial-in / meeting invite and any pre-read (SOW + acceptance checklist).

We will loop in our security lead (cc'd procurement for processing the invoice). Looking forward to the kickoff.
